rules.description: Publication candidate must not use legacy slug as primary
Canonical registry entry must have canonical_plugin_slug
Canonical registry entry must have display_plugin_name
Legacy alias must not be counted as separate canonical example
Dryrun path must use canonical slug, not generic slug without alias record
source-provenance canonical_url must match registry canonical_url
README title must not use generic operation name
BarCode generic names must not appear in publication candidate list
Publication matrix must not include identity_review_required as clean
Family-level probe must not be counted as plugin-level coverage
Canonical identity map must include family plugin list
Final summary must not count canonical and legacy aliases together
